spec.text: **Host** selects resource measurements below; All keeps one series per host or service instance. **Gateway traffic and usage metering are fleet-wide**: their current exported metrics do not carry the host mapping. Do not infer a host from the collector address. Missing measurements are unavailable. [Database & usage metering](/projects/praxis/dashboards/enmaas-accounting) · [Gateway detail](/projects/praxis/dashboards/enmaas-gateway) · [Benchmark results](/projects/praxis/dashboards/enmaas-benchmark) are separate.

display.name: Host CPU used
display.description:
MEANING
Busy CPU divided by total Linux host CPU capacity; all vCPUs together equal 100%. Warning 85%, critical 95%. Browser and generator on macOS are outside this host.

Time: selected dashboard end time. Missing or stale data is unavailable, not zero.

Colors: green below warning; orange at warning; red at critical. Alert rules may require a sustained duration.

TIME WINDOW
Snapshot at the selected end time.

SCOPE
One value per selected host; never a sum of percentages. Select one host for a compact view. Color bands describe pressure; alert rules have their own duration thresholds.

display.name: Host memory pressure
display.description:
MEANING
Total minus MemAvailable, divided by total RAM. Reclaimable cache is available capacity. Warning 85%, critical 92%.

Time: selected dashboard end time. Missing or stale data is unavailable, not zero.

Colors: green below warning; orange at warning; red at critical. Alert rules may require a sustained duration.

TIME WINDOW
Snapshot at the selected end time.

SCOPE
One value per selected host; never a sum of percentages. Select one host for a compact view. Color bands describe pressure; alert rules have their own duration thresholds.

display.name: Firing critical alerts
display.description:
MEANING
Fleet-wide operational alerts; excludes benchmark generator alerts. A zero count means no firing alerts, not proof that every collector is healthy.

TIME WINDOW
Snapshot at the selected end time.

display.name: Firing warning alerts
display.description:
MEANING
Fleet-wide operational alerts; excludes benchmark generator alerts. A zero count means no firing alerts, not proof that every collector is healthy.

TIME WINDOW
Snapshot at the selected end time.

spec.text: Public responses are counted once. Provider calls are internal hops and must not be added to public requests. Duration includes streaming and provider time; it is not proxy overhead or time to first token.

display.name: Public throughput
display.description:
MEANING
Completed public responses per second over two minutes, including denials and errors. Neutral color: higher traffic is not automatically worse.

Time: selected dashboard end time. Missing or stale data is unavailable, not zero.

TIME WINDOW
Snapshot at the selected end time.

display.name: Active public requests
display.description:
MEANING
Concurrent requests at the public listener. A count, not a percentage: there is no universal service concurrency limit.

Time: selected dashboard end time. Missing or stale data is unavailable, not zero.

TIME WINDOW
Snapshot at the selected end time.

display.name: Mean inference duration
display.description:
MEANING
Mean completed inference duration over two minutes, including streaming and backend delays. Compare with provider response times and resource pressure.

Time: selected dashboard end time. Missing or stale data is unavailable, not zero.

TIME WINDOW
Snapshot at the selected end time.

display.name: Database pool wait (s/s)
display.description:
MEANING
Aggregate pool wait seconds per elapsed second over two minutes. Multiple waiters can exceed 1 s/s. This is not a backlog count.

Time: selected dashboard end time. Missing or stale data is unavailable, not zero.

TIME WINDOW
Snapshot at the selected end time.

display.name: 3xx — redirects
display.description:
MEANING
Redirect responses; not automatically a failure. Fleet-wide public responses per second over two minutes. Zero requires observed public counters and fresh gateway telemetry; absent telemetry remains unavailable.

TIME WINDOW
Measurements over the selected time window; gaps mean no matching samples.

display.name: 4xx — client and policy rejections
display.description:
MEANING
Includes authentication, authorization, quota and rate-limit denials; expected policy enforcement is not a server failure. Fleet-wide public responses per second over two minutes. Zero requires observed public counters and fresh gateway telemetry; absent telemetry remains unavailable.

TIME WINDOW
Measurements over the selected time window; gaps mean no matching samples.

display.name: 5xx — server errors
display.description:
MEANING
Failures reported by the public gateway; inspect upstream responses and traces to identify the cause. Fleet-wide public responses per second over two minutes. Zero requires observed public counters and fresh gateway telemetry; absent telemetry remains unavailable.

TIME WINDOW
Measurements over the selected time window; gaps mean no matching samples.

display.name: Public throughput — selected response classes
display.description:
MEANING
HTTP 200 is included in 2xx alongside other successful status codes. Use Response classes to add redirects or errors. Defaults show 2xx, informational 1xx and unclassified responses. Redirects, client/policy rejections and server errors have separate panels. Fleet-wide public responses only; excludes internal hops.

TIME WINDOW
Measurements over the selected time window; gaps mean no matching samples.

display.name: Internal upstream responses by route and status
display.description:
MEANING
Fleet-wide internal calls, including provider and management routes. Inspect failures here without counting them as additional users.

TIME WINDOW
Measurements over the selected time window; gaps mean no matching samples.

display.name: Active public requests over time
display.description:
MEANING
Concurrent public requests, retaining available exporter identity. Source identities are not a verified host mapping.

TIME WINDOW
Measurements over the selected time window; gaps mean no matching samples.

display.name: Mean inference duration by route
display.description:
MEANING
Mean completed stream duration per inference route. No traffic means undefined. Histograms and first-token timing are not currently exported.

TIME WINDOW
Measurements over the selected time window; gaps mean no matching samples.

display.name: Gateway file descriptor utilization
display.description:
MEANING
Open file descriptors divided by each process limit. Preserve exporter identity; do not sum percentages. Warning starts at 80%.

TIME WINDOW
Measurements over the selected time window; gaps mean no matching samples.

spec.text: Each host has its own 100% CPU and memory capacity. Select fewer hosts for a readable comparison. Memory uses MemAvailable, including reclaimable cache; disk is filesystem capacity, not I/O utilization. CPU warning: 85%; memory pressure: 85%; disk capacity used: 85%.

display.name: CPU utilization by host
display.description:
MEANING
One independently normalized series per selected host. Stale samples are excluded; inspect telemetry age when a host disappears.

TIME WINDOW
Measurements over the selected time window; gaps mean no matching samples.

spec.text: CPU is in cores; memory is in MiB/GiB. Separate series identify host, service and instance. Resource ceilings belong to individual containers, not to the whole deployment. [All service resources](/projects/praxis/dashboards/enmaas-components)

spec.text: Database selects the monitored PostgreSQL engine independently of Host. These engine measurements apply to local PostgreSQL or RDS when a collector supplies them. No source means collection is unavailable, not zero activity. RDS CloudWatch CPU, IOPS, storage latency and credits require a separate integration; they are not Linux host metrics.

display.name: Database connections
display.description:
MEANING
Connections to the metering database. The server connection limit is shared by all databases, so this is not a whole-server utilization percentage.

TIME WINDOW
Measurements over the selected time window; gaps mean no matching samples.

display.name: Database size
display.description:
MEANING
Metering database size; excludes unrelated databases and WAL. Not the RDS allocated storage size.

TIME WINDOW
Measurements over the selected time window; gaps mean no matching samples.

display.name: Committed transactions per second
display.description:
MEANING
PostgreSQL engine transaction rate, separate from inference requests.

TIME WINDOW
Measurements over the selected time window; gaps mean no matching samples.

display.name: Database lock waiters
display.description:
MEANING
Sessions waiting on a database lock; distinct from PriceTag connection-pool waiting.

TIME WINDOW
Measurements over the selected time window; gaps mean no matching samples.

display.name: Database deadlocks — last 2 minutes
display.description:
MEANING
Deadlocks detected by PostgreSQL; zero is valid only with a present source.

TIME WINDOW
Measurements over the selected time window; gaps mean no matching samples.

display.name: Database temporary writes
display.description:
MEANING
Temporary file writes reported by PostgreSQL. This is not physical disk IOPS or storage latency.

TIME WINDOW
Measurements over the selected time window; gaps mean no matching samples.

spec.text: Usage recording correctness is independent of successful inference. These service-wide metrics and alerts are not filtered by Host. Generator alerts belong to the Benchmark dashboard.

display.name: Usage recording errors — last 2 minutes
display.description:
MEANING
Any positive count invalidates usage-record verification. Zero does not replace exact ledger reconciliation.

Time: selected dashboard end time. Missing or stale data is unavailable, not zero.

Colors: green below warning; orange at warning; red at critical. Alert rules may require a sustained duration.

TIME WINDOW
Snapshot at the selected end time.

display.name: Database sessions
display.description:
MEANING
Connections to the metering database across monitored database hosts. Compare with server limits in Database & usage metering.

Time: selected dashboard end time. Missing or stale data is unavailable, not zero.

TIME WINDOW
Snapshot at the selected end time.

display.name: Firing operational alerts
display.description:
MEANING
Fleet-wide operational alerts. Host/service/instance identify the affected resource when supplied by the rule. Empty means no firing alerts.

TIME WINDOW
Snapshot at the selected end time.
